description: Check one text against the limits of 13 places at once: X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube title and description, Pinterest, Telegram and SMS. For each one: the limit, the counted length (X counts links as 23 and emoji as 2), characters left, does it fit, a shortened version that fits, what shows before 'more', hashtag limits and SMS parts. Plus words, hashtags, mentions, links and emoji in the text. For schedulers, CMS plugins and marketing sheets. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/social-post-checker.
